semantic_fidelity.reason: Direct RMS-to-compute-BMC and RMS-to-power control absent; physical LAN conflated with APIs. An unsupported directed driver→Fabric Manager relation and an air-gap connection are drawn; residency and qualifications omitted.

arrow_traceability.reason: The one visible junction adjoins a bridge over the middle arrow, so the required three-way split and bus-wide label cannot be traced confidently. v2 dashed arrow depicts separation as a directed link.

layout_fit.reason: The required rack hw title loses its a to the Power shelf arrowhead, and cross-view coverage is incomplete. The 77×47 dumps are not captures of an actual 77×47 live pane; independent fit proof is missing.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Actual region geometry fails to contain and identify off-rack management, rack members, NVSwitch software, and compute-host plane; related colors/proximity do not recover the omitted placement.

category_fit.reason: Placement-planes is plausible and a source-backed family line plus secondary identity recipe exist, but separate titled side-by-side worlds are not rendered, the bus is ambiguous, and source qualifier coverage is incomplete. The line incorrectly describes the bus as joining the OOB and in-band worlds.

border_integrity.reason: All 23 node outlines, normal and select-all, have all four sides and corners, with one continuous RGB color per node; the damaged rack-region title is not a node border and is charged to fit/grouping. Select-all is one simultaneous frame, not per-node interactive captures.

workflow_evidence.reason: Model identities, hashes, blind record, check outputs, ANSI and static frames are present, and family line is in generation.json. Raw calibration probe outputs, rejected spec bytes and exact per-attempt commands are not preserved; fifth pane identity/close proof and actual target-size live pane are missing.

animation.reason: Static submission has no flow-dot glyphs in timestamped 83×51 or pinned 77×47 frames, and source does not request animation. Motion rules are vacuous; no dot violations.

findings.description: RMS direct Redfish/HTTPS control of compute BMC and power shelf is absent; LAN-client attachment plus physical LAN drops does not establish controller API calls. Source correction explicitly requires them.

One ┴ at [39,41] immediately adjoins ⌒ [38,41] over the NVSwitch head; an apparent crossing rather than a single clean three-way split makes the middle path and Redfish/HTTPS bus ownership uncertain. The shared-cells warning is not itself sufficient to reject an intentional bus.
The OOB→in-band net dashed arrow labelled air-gapped turns a usually separate/non-connected relationship into a directed link and drops the usually qualification; dashed styling does not say usually.

NVOS→NMX hosts and SSH/SFTP are visible, but no NVSwitch tray/host region establishes NVOS residency; NVUE label omits REST. Compute host residency for DCGM, driver/CUDA and Fabric Manager is also absent.
Unlabelled driver+CUDA→Fabric Manager arrow invents a directed relationship: bundled is not a verb, and the source requires supported read/monitor/host semantics or a block.

GPU Operator→DCGM lacks explicit deploys; DCGM (DaemonSet) does not alone specify the action. Exporter→network is unlabeled; metrics appears on DCGM→exporter. The licensing caveat and usually qualifier are outside the captured diagram.
The required group title rack hw is rendered r▼ck hw, one glyph overwritten by the arrowhead at [55,42]. Target dumps have full nodes but the v3 UI header is clipped at 77×47.

v1 rack hw frame contains only the shelf; compute and switch BMCs sit outside; off-rack management and OOB labels vanish into displaced fragments. v2/v4 similarly have missing region corners/titles; v3 has no switch region and v4 no compute host region.

The source-backed placement-planes evidence line is recorded in generation.json, but the required side-by-side worlds and region memberships are not present in captures; the middle bus connection is ambiguous and qualifier coverage is incomplete.

Rejected draft specs overwritten; calibration probe raw logs expressly not kept; attempt records contain exit/status and checks but not exact commands. Only four pane IDs/confirmed closures are individually preserved although five panes are claimed. Actual live pane is 83×51, not required 77×47.
